                      - technique_name: Defacement
                        sub_technique_name: 
                        tactics:
                        - Impact
                        defend:
                          name: Evidentiary Artifact Isolation
                          description: D3FEND focuses on isolating and preserving evidence of defacement attempts through content integrity monitoring and change detection mechanisms. This includes maintaining immutable logs and snapshots of system state before and after potential defacement.
                          considerations:
                          - Implement file integrity monitoring (FIM) on critical web content
                          - Maintain versioning and rollback capabilities for web assets
                          - Log all modifications to hosted content with timestamps and user attribution
                          - Use cryptographic hashing to detect unauthorized changes
                      - technique_name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
                        sub_technique_name: 
                        tactics:
                        - Exfiltration
                        defend:
                          name: Network Segmentation and Protocol Analysis
                          description: D3FEND recommends monitoring and restricting non-standard exfiltration channels through network segmentation, protocol whitelisting, and deep packet inspection. This prevents data loss over alternative protocols not typically used for legitimate business purposes.
                          considerations:
                          - Establish baseline of legitimate protocols used in your environment
                          - Implement egress filtering to block suspicious protocol combinations
                          - Monitor for unusual protocol usage patterns and anomalies
                          - Use DLP (Data Loss Prevention) tools to detect sensitive data in alternative protocols
                      - technique_name: Steal Application Access Token
                        sub_technique_name: 
                        tactics:
                        - Credential Access
                        defend:
                          name: Token Binding and Credential Hardening
                          description: D3FEND emphasizes protecting application tokens through binding mechanisms, short-lived token lifecycles, and secure storage practices. This reduces the window of opportunity for token theft and limits token reuse.
                          considerations:
                          - Implement token binding to device or session context
                          - Use short expiration times for access tokens
                          - Enforce token rotation policies
                          - Monitor for anomalous token usage patterns and geographic inconsistencies
                          - Implement secure token storage with encryption at rest
                      - technique_name: Data Staged
                        sub_technique_name: 
                        tactics:
                        - Collection
                        defend:
                          name: Data Staging Detection and Prevention
                          description: D3FEND focuses on detecting and preventing data aggregation activities through monitoring file system operations, access patterns, and data movement. This includes identifying suspicious staging directories and bulk data operations.
                          considerations:
                          - Monitor for creation of temporary staging directories
                          - Track bulk file copy and move operations
                          - Alert on unusual data aggregation patterns
                          - Implement access controls on temporary storage locations
                          - Log all data staging activities with user and process attribution
                      - technique_name: Data from Information Repositories
                        sub_technique_name: 
                        tactics:
                        - Collection
                        defend:
                          name: Repository Access Control and Monitoring
                          description: D3FEND recommends implementing strict access controls and comprehensive logging for information repositories. This includes monitoring for bulk data exports, unusual query patterns, and unauthorized repository access.
                          considerations:
                          - Enforce principle of least privilege on repository access
                          - Monitor for bulk data exports and unusual query volumes
                          - Implement query rate limiting and anomaly detection
                          - Log all repository access with query details and user attribution
                          - Use data classification to identify sensitive repositories requiring enhanced monitoring
                      - technique_name: Data from Cloud Storage
                        sub_technique_name: 
                        tactics:
                        - Collection
                        defend:
                          name: Cloud Storage Access Control and Audit Logging
                          description: D3FEND emphasizes comprehensive audit logging, access controls, and anomaly detection for cloud storage systems. This includes monitoring API calls, detecting unusual access patterns, and enforcing authentication mechanisms.
                          considerations:
                          - Enable and monitor cloud storage audit logs (CloudTrail, Activity Logs, etc.)
                          - Implement MFA for cloud storage access
                          - Monitor for bulk GetObject/download operations
                          - Alert on access from unusual geographic locations or IP addresses
                          - Enforce bucket/container policies restricting public access
                          - Implement object-level access controls and encryption
                      - technique_name: Cloud Storage Object Discovery
                        sub_technique_name: 
                        tactics:
                        - Discovery
                        defend:
                          name: Cloud Storage Enumeration Prevention
                          description: D3FEND focuses on preventing reconnaissance of cloud storage resources through access controls, API rate limiting, and monitoring enumeration activities. This includes detecting ListBucket and similar discovery operations.
                          considerations:
                          - Restrict ListBucket and similar enumeration permissions
                          - Implement API rate limiting to detect scanning activities
                          - Monitor for repeated failed access attempts
                          - Log all enumeration API calls with source attribution
                          - Use resource tagging to identify sensitive storage objects
                          - Implement conditional access policies based on risk factors
                      - technique_name: Poisoned Pipeline Execution
                        sub_technique_name: 
                        tactics:
                        - Execution
                        defend:
                          name: Pipeline Integrity Verification and Source Control Security
                          description: D3FEND recommends securing CI/CD pipelines through code signing, source control access controls, and execution environment isolation. This prevents injection of malicious code into build and deployment processes.
                          considerations:
                          - Implement code signing and verification for pipeline artifacts
                          - Enforce branch protection rules and code review requirements
                          - Monitor for unauthorized pipeline configuration changes
                          - Isolate pipeline execution environments with minimal privileges
                          - Audit all pipeline modifications and deployments
                          - Implement secrets management to prevent credential exposure in pipelines

                        sub_technique_name: Databases
                        tactics:

                        defend:
                          name: Database Access Control and Query Monitoring
                          description: D3FEND emphasizes database-specific security controls including query auditing, access restrictions, and anomaly detection. This prevents unauthorized data extraction from database systems.
                          considerations:
                          - Enable database audit logging for all queries and access
                          - Implement row-level and column-level security controls
                          - Monitor for bulk data exports and unusual query patterns
                          - Enforce strong authentication and MFA for database access
                          - Implement query rate limiting and resource quotas
                          - Use database activity monitoring (DAM) tools for real-time detection

                        sub_technique_name: Confluence
                        tactics:

                          - Monitor for bulk content exports and unusual download patterns
                          - Enable Confluence audit logging and review access logs regularly
                          - Implement MFA for Confluence access
                          - Monitor for API token abuse and unusual API activity
                          - Restrict export functionality to authorized users only

defend.name: Evidentiary Artifact Isolation
defend.description: D3FEND focuses on isolating and preserving evidence of defacement attempts through content integrity monitoring and change detection mechanisms. This includes maintaining immutable logs and snapshots of system state before and after potential defacement.
considerations: Implement file integrity monitoring (FIM) on critical web content
Maintain versioning and rollback capabilities for web assets
Log all modifications to hosted content with timestamps and user attribution
Use cryptographic hashing to detect unauthorized changes

defend.name: Network Segmentation and Protocol Analysis
defend.description: D3FEND recommends monitoring and restricting non-standard exfiltration channels through network segmentation, protocol whitelisting, and deep packet inspection. This prevents data loss over alternative protocols not typically used for legitimate business purposes.
considerations: Establish baseline of legitimate protocols used in your environment
Implement egress filtering to block suspicious protocol combinations
Monitor for unusual protocol usage patterns and anomalies
Use DLP (Data Loss Prevention) tools to detect sensitive data in alternative protocols

defend.name: Token Binding and Credential Hardening
defend.description: D3FEND emphasizes protecting application tokens through binding mechanisms, short-lived token lifecycles, and secure storage practices. This reduces the window of opportunity for token theft and limits token reuse.
considerations: Implement token binding to device or session context
Use short expiration times for access tokens
Enforce token rotation policies
Monitor for anomalous token usage patterns and geographic inconsistencies
Implement secure token storage with encryption at rest

defend.name: Data Staging Detection and Prevention
defend.description: D3FEND focuses on detecting and preventing data aggregation activities through monitoring file system operations, access patterns, and data movement. This includes identifying suspicious staging directories and bulk data operations.
considerations: Monitor for creation of temporary staging directories
Track bulk file copy and move operations
Alert on unusual data aggregation patterns
Implement access controls on temporary storage locations
Log all data staging activities with user and process attribution

defend.name: Repository Access Control and Monitoring
defend.description: D3FEND recommends implementing strict access controls and comprehensive logging for information repositories. This includes monitoring for bulk data exports, unusual query patterns, and unauthorized repository access.
considerations: Enforce principle of least privilege on repository access
Monitor for bulk data exports and unusual query volumes
Implement query rate limiting and anomaly detection
Log all repository access with query details and user attribution
Use data classification to identify sensitive repositories requiring enhanced monitoring

defend.name: Cloud Storage Access Control and Audit Logging
defend.description: D3FEND emphasizes comprehensive audit logging, access controls, and anomaly detection for cloud storage systems. This includes monitoring API calls, detecting unusual access patterns, and enforcing authentication mechanisms.
considerations: Enable and monitor cloud storage audit logs (CloudTrail, Activity Logs, etc.)
Implement MFA for cloud storage access
Monitor for bulk GetObject/download operations
Alert on access from unusual geographic locations or IP addresses
Enforce bucket/container policies restricting public access
Implement object-level access controls and encryption

defend.name: Cloud Storage Enumeration Prevention
defend.description: D3FEND focuses on preventing reconnaissance of cloud storage resources through access controls, API rate limiting, and monitoring enumeration activities. This includes detecting ListBucket and similar discovery operations.
considerations: Restrict ListBucket and similar enumeration permissions
Implement API rate limiting to detect scanning activities
Monitor for repeated failed access attempts
Log all enumeration API calls with source attribution
Use resource tagging to identify sensitive storage objects
Implement conditional access policies based on risk factors

defend.name: Pipeline Integrity Verification and Source Control Security
defend.description: D3FEND recommends securing CI/CD pipelines through code signing, source control access controls, and execution environment isolation. This prevents injection of malicious code into build and deployment processes.
considerations: Implement code signing and verification for pipeline artifacts
Enforce branch protection rules and code review requirements
Monitor for unauthorized pipeline configuration changes
Isolate pipeline execution environments with minimal privileges
Audit all pipeline modifications and deployments
Implement secrets management to prevent credential exposure in pipelines

considerations: Enable database audit logging for all queries and access
Implement row-level and column-level security controls
Monitor for bulk data exports and unusual query patterns
Enforce strong authentication and MFA for database access
Implement query rate limiting and resource quotas
Use database activity monitoring (DAM) tools for real-time detection
